service.name: Evidex Evidence Pack
service.positioning: 48-hour evidence pack for grant, audit, donor, and compliance reporting.

tiers.name: Pilot Pack
tiers.description: One small review pack from supplied files, suitable for a first client demo.

tiers.name: NGO Standard Pack
tiers.description: Structured evidence table, narrative, source folder, quality report, and delivery ZIP.

tiers.name: Consultant Batch Pack
tiers.description: Per-pack reseller rate when supplied in batches of 3 or more.

tiers.name: Urgent 48h Pack
tiers.description: Priority turnaround for deadline-driven reporting or audit preparation.

required_client_questions: What organization or project name should appear on the pack?
What reporting period does this evidence cover?
Who is the donor, funder, auditor, or client receiving the pack?
Is there a donor template, logframe, KPI sheet, rubric, or reporting checklist?
Which evidence files are primary proof, and which are supporting context?
Are there sensitive files or personal data that should be excluded or redacted?
What deadline and delivery format should be used?
